purpose: Evidence packet only. Every fact is grounded in a directly read official airline page. A missing placement is intentionally not inferred.

provenance_defaults.reviewer: Codex — lecture directe de la page officielle

facts.condition_scope: official ceiling applies to pet plus carrier; a dog below 8 kg is not positively cleared without carrier weight
facts.finder_effect: For a 30 or 32 kg dog, cabin is not suitable.
facts.locator: Travel options for pets → Pets in cabin

facts.condition_scope: bigger dogs; maximum pet plus container 75 kg on Finnair-operated flights or 50 kg on Norra-operated flights; aircraft, route, connection and booking conditions apply
facts.finder_effect: For a 30 or 32 kg dog, show hold offered under conditions, never an availability guarantee.
facts.quote: Bigger dogs and ferrets can travel in the hold on the same flight with you.
facts.locator: Travel options for pets → Pets in aircraft hold

facts.condition_scope: required over 75 kg combined on Finnair or 50 kg on Norra, and in named route or unaccompanied cases; a forwarding company books the service
facts.finder_effect: Present cargo as a conditional alternative, not as acceptance of any dog on any route.
facts.quote: Your pet will need to be shipped as separately cargo.
facts.locator: Travel options for pets → Pets as cargo

facts.condition_scope: official ceiling applies to pet plus carrier; business-class, route and aircraft exceptions apply
facts.finder_effect: For a 30 or 32 kg dog, cabin is not suitable.
facts.locator: Pet in cabin → Pet carrier requirements

facts.condition_scope: dogs and cats only; maximum 50 kg including pet; aircraft, route and breed exclusions apply, including named brachycephalic dogs
facts.finder_effect: For a large non-brachycephalic dog, show hold offered under conditions; do not offer it for the explicitly excluded breeds.
facts.quote: If your pet doesn’t meet the criteria to travel in the cabin, it will need to travel in the cargo hold.

facts.condition_scope: official ceiling applies to animal plus transport container; flights to or from UK are separately excluded from passenger pet carriage
facts.finder_effect: For a 30 or 32 kg dog, cabin is not suitable.
facts.locator: Cats and small dogs in the cabin → Which conditions apply for a transport in the cabin?

facts.condition_scope: cats and dogs; no stated animal weight limit, but container maximum 125 × 75 × 85 cm; route, date and booking exclusions apply
facts.finder_effect: For a large dog, show hold offered under conditions; retain the carrier-dimension, destination and seasonal exceptions.
facts.quote: Your cat or dog will be well taken care of and will travel in a ventilated part of the aircraft hold.
facts.locator: Cats and dogs in the hold → How will my pet travel?

facts.condition_scope: required for containers larger than passenger-hold maximum and for pets to or from UK; shipment-agent and route requirements apply
facts.finder_effect: Present cargo only as a conditional alternate mode.
facts.quote: Larger containers have to be sent as cargo.
facts.locator: Cats and dogs in the hold → Which conditions apply for a transport in the hold?

facts.condition_scope: cats and dogs only when size, age and destination requirements are met; the page does not state a simple kilogram threshold
facts.finder_effect: Do not fabricate a weight-based cabin answer from this source. Offer a documented conditional cabin path only when the route rules are met.
facts.quote: Carry-on pets are limited to cats and dogs that meet the size, age and destination requirements.
facts.locator: Carry on or transport your pet

facts.condition_scope: checked pets are limited to active-duty US military and US State Department Foreign Service personnel travelling on official orders
facts.finder_effect: For a normal passenger, do not offer passenger-hold transport; keep the official-order exception out of the ordinary pet flow.
facts.quote: We only accept checked pets for active-duty U.S. military and U.S. State Department Foreign Service personnel traveling on official orders.

facts.condition_scope: for pets not qualifying as carry-on or checked pets; route, kennel and booking restrictions apply
facts.finder_effect: For a large dog, present cargo as a documented conditional route, not a booking assurance.
facts.quote: American Airlines Cargo offers the American PetEmbark service for pets that don’t qualify to travel as carry-on or checked pets.

facts.condition_scope: dogs and cats as checked baggage, route, aircraft, breed and country exceptions apply; pet plus container over 32 kg must be arranged through cargo
facts.finder_effect: Show checked-baggage hold under conditions only. The lack of a cabin quote means cabin remains prudent.
facts.quote: Your pet can travel with you on the same flight as checked baggage.

facts.condition_scope: combined pet(s) and container weight above 32 kg; cargo-agent arrangements required
facts.finder_effect: A 32 kg dog cannot be positively placed in hold without container weight; above 32 kg combined, point to cargo.
facts.quote: if the combined weight of your pet(s) and its container exceeds 32kg, please make travel arrangements for your pet(s) via a cargo agent.

intentionally_unset.reason: The directly read official page documents checked baggage and cargo but gives no explicit ordinary-pet cabin rule. Do not derive a denial from silence.
